title: Quorum reviewers that VERIFY and HONE (agentic, repo-armed) — two-tier escalation over the frozen text quorum

executor_constraints.worktree: Work in an isolated git worktree branched from origin/dev. NEVER the shared main tree. Commit promptly (concurrent-agent safety).
executor_constraints.frozen_contract: The shipped verdict contract is FROZEN: do NOT change ReviewResult's three required fields (verdict, strongest_objection, catch), ValidateReviewResult (reject-by-default), reviewSchema's required[], the N-1 degradation, or artifact recording. proposed_fix is PURELY ADDITIVE and OPTIONAL and NOT validated (Mark decision option (a), 2026-07-16).
executor_constraints.reuse_not_rebuild: REUSE the existing executor layer (internal/coordinator/provider_executor.go): read-only tool mode (AllowedTools, provider_executor.go:122-124), Execute(ctx) cancellation, opts.Timeout/IdleTimeout, result.Cost=execResult.CostUSD, opts.Workspace worktree. Do NOT build new executor plumbing. The new agentic backend rides behind the EXISTING JSONCaller seam (call.go:35).
executor_constraints.no_gpu_ollama: No GPU/ollama steps anywhere. Reviewers are frontier API/agentic models only.
executor_constraints.bounded_waits: Every wait/agentic run must be bounded (hard turn + time cap; no unbounded until-loops). A cap breach fails to N-1 degradation, never blocks the loop.
executor_constraints.no_merge_authority: Reviewers verify and object only. They get zero write access to the shared tree and do NOT gate merges by themselves — the controller still synthesizes verdicts (quorum.go synthesize()).
executor_constraints.sequencing: M0 (network probe) is a HARD GATE and MUST run and be evaluated FIRST. Its result decides whether the gemini/managed_agents reviewer verifies-in-sandbox (clone path) or falls back to prompt-packed excerpts / text tier. M2 (escalation trigger) can proceed independently of M0's result. M3 (agentic backend) depends on M1; the gemini sub-path within M3/M4 depends on M0's outcome. M5 last.

velocity.basis: Design estimates ~2-3d phase-gated (escalation tier ~1d; full agentic-reviewer backend ~2d). Recent mission sprints (M-DX-EXAMPLES-COVERAGE 5 milestones ~15h/2d; M-PRELUDE-OPTION-RESULT, M-XMOD-ALIAS-POLY single-milestone same-day) support ~250 LOC/day. This sprint is mostly wiring over an existing, verified executor + quorum frame, not new subsystems, but the M0 probe is an external-network unknown — hence phase-gating rather than a flat 3-day commit.

features.description: GATE. One cheap managed_agents (Gemini, Vertex Managed Agents) interaction that attempts, inside the Google-hosted sandbox: `git clone --depth 1` of the PUBLIC repo at a pinned review SHA, fetch of the linux `ailang` release binary (curl), and `ailang --version`. Capture and report whether outbound network (git/curl) is PERMITTED in the sandbox. The RESULT is a decision point for the whole sprint: PERMITTED => gemini reviewer verifies-in-sandbox (clone path, M3/M4 gemini sub-path enabled); BLOCKED => gemini falls back to prompt-packed excerpts (weaker, must be flagged as unverified) or stays a Tier-1 text-only reviewer. NEVER silently pretend it verified.
features.gate: HARD. Run FIRST. Record result in the sprint notes + design doc Verification Log BEFORE M3's gemini sub-path is attempted.

implementation.approach: Reuse the existing managed_agents executor via coordinator.NewExecutorProvider("managed_agents") with a Kind=="question" (read-only) task whose directive is the probe script. Do NOT build new plumbing. Bounded: hard time cap (e.g. opts.Timeout ~5m) + single interaction.
implementation.probe_directive: Instruct the agent to run: git clone --depth 1 <pinned-SHA public repo>; curl -fsSL <linux ailang release binary URL> -o ailang && chmod +x ailang; ./ailang --version; then report exact success/failure of each step and any network error text verbatim.
implementation.output: A short structured report (network_permitted: bool, git_clone: ok|blocked|error, curl_fetch: ok|blocked|error, ailang_version: string|none, raw_errors: text). Persist under .ailang/state/mission-quorum/ or the sprint notes as decision evidence.
implementation.no_silent_fallback: If the probe itself cannot run (auth/quota/executor error), that is an EXPLICIT inconclusive result, not a 'blocked' and not a 'permitted' — report it as inconclusive and default gemini to Tier-1 text until re-probed (Principle 2).

features.description: Introduce an agentic reviewer backend behind the EXISTING JSONCaller interface (call.go:35). A new caller type wraps coordinator.NewExecutorProvider(name) (codex=OpenAI, claude, managed_agents=Gemini), runs a read-only (Kind=="question") agentic review over a repo worktree, and returns the SAME {verdict, strongest_objection, catch} JSON. The agentic call is instructed to actually verify each premise (run `ailang check`, grep, read) and cite the check it ran in `catch`. No change to ReviewResult, ValidateReviewResult, reviewSchema, or synthesize.

features.description: Two-tier escalation logic (~the '1d escalation tier'). Tier 1 = the shipped text quorum, ALWAYS runs, unchanged. Tier 2 = agentic verification, triggered ONLY when: (a) any Tier-1 reviewer's objection is PREMISE-class (a disputed factual codebase claim), OR (b) the doc self-declares high-stakes (touches shared infra / a Conflict Surface), OR (c) Tier-1 is split (pass/reject disagreement). Escalation targets the specific contested premise, not the whole doc. Also add the additive OPTIONAL proposed_fix field to the ReviewResult JSON (unvalidated, prompt-encouraged) per Mark option (a).

implementation.trigger: A pure function ShouldEscalate(quorumResult, docSelfDeclaredHighStakes bool) (escalate bool, contestedPremise string). Premise-class detection: classify a Tier-1 objection as premise-class when it disputes a factual codebase claim (heuristic on the objection text + a doc self-declaration marker); split = mixed pass/reject among present reviewers (already computable from synthesize()); high-stakes = a doc front-matter / Conflict-Surface self-declaration flag.
implementation.proposed_fix_field: Add `proposed_fix string `json:"proposed_fix,omitempty"`` to ReviewResult (ADDITIVE, OPTIONAL). Do NOT add it to reviewSchema.required and do NOT reference it in ValidateReviewResult. Add it to reviewSchema.properties only. Reviewers are PROMPTED to include a concrete fix on every reject; a fix-less reject is recorded as reviewer friction (a note), NEVER a validation error.
implementation.self_declaration: Support a doc self-declaring high-stakes (e.g. a 'Conflict surface' section presence / an explicit stakes marker) as an escalation input; parse from the doc body already available to BuildPrompt.

features.description: CONDITIONAL ON M0. If M0 reported outbound network PERMITTED: enable the gemini/managed_agents Tier-2 reviewer via clone-in-sandbox (git clone --depth 1 at the pinned SHA + fetch linux ailang binary + ailang check), returning the same verdict JSON. If M0 reported BLOCKED or INCONCLUSIVE: gemini falls back to prompt-packed excerpts (reviewer sees only what we send — weaker, EXPLICITLY flagged as unverified in the outcome) or stays a Tier-1 text reviewer. features.conditional: SKIP-OR-FALLBACK per M0. If M0=PERMITTED => implement clone path. If M0=BLOCKED/INCONCLUSIVE => implement the flagged prompt-packed fallback ONLY (no clone) and mark gemini reviews as verification-degraded.

implementation.no_pretend: Whichever path, the outcome must state whether it actually ran ailang check in-sandbox or only reasoned over packed excerpts (Principle 2).

handoff.estimated_duration: 2-3 days (~23 hours across 6 milestones), phase-gated at M0
handoff.recommendation: PHASE-GATE THIS ITERATION AT M0. Execute M0 first (with M1 + M2 in parallel, since they are independent of M0's result), then PAUSE for the controller/human to read M0's PERMITTED|BLOCKED|INCONCLUSIVE result before committing to M4's gemini clone sub-path. M3 (codex+claude local-worktree Tier-2) delivers the core 'verify, not just reason' capability regardless of M0 and can proceed.
